# RegisterBox

Business registration preparation and compliance workspaces in India. Based in Bengaluru.

- [Services](https://www.registerbox.in/services)
- [Contact](https://www.registerbox.in/contact)
- [Privacy and service information](https://www.registerbox.in/policies)

Application drafts are not government submissions. Confirm scope and fees with the team.

## Business questions and guides

These public English-language guides contain practical examples, preparation checklists and linked official sources. Publication date: 20 October 2026.

- [GST registration documents: getting your address proof right](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/gst-registration-documents-and-address-proof): A practical GST registration checklist for owned, rented and family premises, with ways to resolve name and address mismatches before you apply.
- [GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B: what each return does and what to check](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/gstr-1-vs-gstr-3b): Understand the difference between GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, how to compare records and input credit, and what proves that filing is complete.
- [No sales this month: can I file a nil GSTR-3B?](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/no-sales-nil-gstr-3b): No sales does not automatically mean a nil GST return. Check purchases, input credit, reverse charge, adjustments and outstanding charges first.
- [FSSAI for a home kitchen or cloud kitchen: where to start in 2026](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/fssai-home-kitchen-cloud-kitchen): Check the current FSSAI route for a home food business or cloud kitchen, including the April 2026 thresholds, activity classification and documents.
- [Private limited company registration: what founders should decide before filing](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/private-limited-company-registration-documents): A practical company registration guide covering ownership, director and office documents, SPICe+, costs and the work that follows incorporation.
- [LLP registration: the partner decisions that matter before the forms](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/llp-registration-partner-agreement): Understand LLP registration, partner contributions, profit sharing, the LLP agreement, FiLLiP and the records needed to start with a clear arrangement.
- [How to start a small business: a practical proprietorship checklist](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/start-business-sole-proprietorship-checklist): Decide your business structure, map registrations, prepare an address record and set up everyday bookkeeping before your first sale.
- [Shop and establishment registration in Karnataka: prepare the right details](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/shop-establishment-registration-karnataka): Understand what to check for a Karnataka shop or office, how to organise establishment records and why GST and other permissions are separate.
- [Starting an online business in India: the questions to settle before selling](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/start-online-ecommerce-business-india): Plan products, marketplace roles, warehouses, customer policies and registration checks before your online business takes its first order.
- [Manufacturing business approvals: what to check before taking a premises](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/manufacturing-business-approvals-checklist): A clear manufacturing setup checklist covering process details, site suitability, approval stages, technical documents and changes in capacity.
- [Opening a new business branch: address, GST and local registration checks](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/open-new-business-branch-gst): Plan a new shop, office or warehouse with clear location evidence, a GST review, local approval checks and a branch record that matches the business.
- [How to check your business compliance without getting lost in certificates](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/business-compliance-check-checklist): Review registrations, filings, locations and notices using real evidence, then turn gaps into a practical list of actions and responsible owners.
- [Trademark registration: check your name, logo and business category first](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/trademark-registration-name-logo-search): Learn how a trademark search, applicant choice, goods and services description and application status fit together before you spend on your brand.

- [Editorial approach](https://www.registerbox.in/blog/editorial-policy)
- [All business guides](https://www.registerbox.in/blog)
